book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Irail Salihedi Sises

Mwurin Sises eh ketin wia kasakas wet, e ahpw ketida sang wasao iang sapwellime tohnpadahk ko oh kotehla piletik en Kidron. Eri, mwetuwel ehu mie wasao, me ih oh sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ketilong loale.
Eri, Sudas, me pahn pangala Sises, ese duwen wasao, pwehki pak tohto Sises oh sapwellime tohnpadahk ko kin tuhpene ie.
Sudas eri patohla nan mwetuwelo, ahpw kahre sounpei en Rom kei oh silepen Tehnpas Sarawio kei me pekedersang rehn samworo lapalap ako oh Parisi ko. Irail koaros wisik tehtehn pei, lamp oh ndil kei.
Sises ketin mwahngih mehkoaros me pahn wiawihong; e ahpw ketida mwohrail oh mahsanih, “Ihs me kumwail raparapahki?”
Re ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Sises, mehn Nasaret.” Sises ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Ngehi Iei ih.” Sudas, me pangala Sises, iang irail kesikesihnen wasao.
Ni Sises eh ketin mahsanihong irail, “Ngehi Iei ih,” re ahpw pweieklahsang oh pwupwudiong nan pwehl.
Sises pil pwurehng kalelapak rehrail, mahsanih, “Ihs me kumwail raparapahki?” Irail eri patohwan, “Sises, mehn Nasaret.”
Sises ahpw mahsanih, “I ndaiongkumwailehr me Ngehi Iei ih. Eri, ma kumwail raparapahkin ie, kumwail mweidohng ohl pwukat re en kohkohla.”
(E ketin mahsanih met pwe me e ketin mahsanihero en pweida: “Semei, sohte emen rehn me komw ketikihongieier ko me salongala.”)
Eri, Saimon Piter, me weuwa kedlahs pwoat, ahpw usada oh pelehki en Samworo Lapalap eh ladu, oh pelehsang salenge palimaun. Eden ladu menet, Malkus.
Sises ahpw ketin mahsanihong Piter, “Kapwurehiong noumw kedlahs en nan dewe! Ia duwe, ke lemeleme me I sohte pahn nimasang dahl en lokolok me Semei ketikihongieier?”
Sises Mwohn Anas
Sounpei en Rom ko iangahki arail kaun, oh pil silepen mehn Suhs ko, re ahpw koledi Sises oh salihedi.
Irail kahluwalahng Sises mahs rehn Anas, pwehki ih me semen en Kaiapas eh pwoud, oh Kaiapas, iei ih me Samworo Lapalap nan pahro.
Eri, Kaiapas, iei ih ohlo me ndaiong mehn Suhs ako me mwahu ma aramastehmen en mehkihla aramas koaros.
Piter Kahmahmki Sises
Saimon Piter, oh pil emen tohnpadahk, ira ahpw idawehnla Sises. Eri, pwehki Samworo Lapalapo ese tohnpadahk teio, ihme eh iangki Sises ketilong nan palangk en tehnpas en Samworo Lapalapo.
A Piter uh liki, limwahn wenihmwo. Eri, tohnpadahk teio, me Samworo Lapalap eseo, ahpw pedoi oh koasoakoasoiong lidu me sinsile wenihmwo, oh kahluwalong Piter loaleo.
Lidu me sinsile wenihmwo ahpw idek rehn Piter, “Kaidehn kowe emen nein ohlo tohnpadahk ko?” Piter ahpw sapeng, nda, “Soh. Kaidehn.”
Eri, lidu ko oh silepe ko saundahr kisiniei kis, pwehki eh kopou. Irail eri kapilpene oh wie rengreng wasao; oh Piter pil iang irail wie rengreng.
Samworo Lapalap Kapeidek Sises
Samworo Lapalapo ahpw kalelapak rehn Sises duwen sapwellime tohnpadahk ko oh pil duwen sapwellime padahk.

Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “I kin kalap koasoi sansal ong aramas koaros. Ei padahk koaros wiawiher nan sinakoke kan oh pil nan Tehnpas Sarawio, wasa me mehn Suhs akan koaros kin pokonpene ie. I sohte mwahn nda mehkot wasa rir.
Dahme kahrehda komw keinemwehki rehi? Komw keinemwe rehrail me rongasang ie duwen mehkan me I padahkihong irail; irail me ese dahme I ndaier.”
Ni Sises eh mahsaniher mepwukat, emen silepeo ko, me uh mpe, ahpw pohr Sises oh nda, “Ih duwen omw pasapeng ong Samworo Lapalap men?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng ohlo, mahsanih, “Ma ei lokaia me sapwung, a kadehdehda duwen ei sapwung; a ma ei lokaia me pwung, a mehnda ke pohr ie?”
Eri, Anas ahpw kadarala Sises rehn Samworo Lapalap Kaiapas ni eh senselte.
Piter Pwurehng Kahmahmki Sises
Piter eri wie kesikesihnente wie rengreng. Irail ahpw ndaiong, “Kaidehn kowe emen nah tohnpadahk ko?” Piter ahpw sapeng, nda, “Kaidehn.”
Ladu en Samworo Lapalapo men, kisehn ohl me Piter pelehsangehr salenge, ahpw idek, “Kaidehn kowe me I kilang eh iang ohlo nan mwetuwelo?”
Piter ahpw pil pwurehng kahmahmki; oh ni ahnsowohte malek emen ahpw kakorot.
Sises Ket Mwohn Pailet

Nimensehngie re ahpw kahrehsang Sises nan tehnpas en Kaiapas oh kahrelahng nan tehnpas en kepina. Ahpw re sohte pedolong nan tehnpas en kepinao, pwe re de saminkihla, pwe re en kak tungoale kamadipw en Pahsohpa.
Pailet eri pedoila rehrail oh mahsanih, “Dahme kumwail kedipahki ohl menet?”
Irail ahpw patohwanohng, “Se sohte pahn kahrehdo ohl menet rehmwi ma e sohte wiahda mehkot suwed.”
Pailet eri mahsanihong irail, “Pein kumwail ale ohl menet oh kadeikada nin duwen amwail kosonned.” Mehn Suhs ako ahpw patohwanohng, “E sohte mweimweiong kiht se en kemehla aramas.”
(Met wiawiher pwe mahseno en pweida, me Sises mahsaniher, pwe en kasalehda soangen pwoula me e pahn pwoukihla.)
Pailet eri pwurolong nan tehnpese, ahpw ekerolong Sises, oh peidek reh, patohwan, “Ia duwe, komwi me nanmwarkien mehn Suhs akan?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Komw mahsanih peidek wet sang ni kupwuromwi, de ekei aramas me patohwanohng komwi duwen ngehi?”
Pailet ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Da, ngehi mehn Suhs men? Aramas en omwi wehi, oh pil arail samworo lapalap akan, iei irail me pangodohng komwi rehi. Eri, dahme komw ketin wiahda?”

Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Ei wehi, kaidehn kisehn sampah wet. A ma ei wehi kisehn sampah wet, ei tungoal papah kan pahn peikin ie, pwe emen de pangielahng rehn mehn Suhs akan. Ahpw soh! Ei wehi kaidehn kisehn wasaht!”

Pailet eri pil patohwanohng, “Eri da, nanmwarki men komwi?” Sises ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Komwi me mahsanih me ngehi nanmwarki men. A iei, ong ni kahrepe wette me I kohkidohng sampah, pwe I en kadehdehda duwen me mehlel. Aramas koaros me kisehn mehlel kin rong ngilei.”

Pailet eri patohwan idek, “A dahkot mehlel?” Sises ketin Pengpenglahngehr en Kamakamala (Pil tehk Mad. 27.15-31; Mark 15.6-20; Luk 23.13-25) Pailet eri pil pedoila rehn mehn Suhs ako, oh mahsanihong irail, “I sohte mwahn diarada kahrepe ehu pwe I en kalokehki ohl menet.
A tiahk ehu mie rehmwail, duwen ei kin lapwadahng kumwail emen tohn kalapwuhs ni ahnsoun Pahsohpa. Eri, ia duwe, kumwail sohte men I en lapwadahng kumwail nanmwarkien mehn Suhs kan?”
Irail ahpw werda, ndinda, “Kaidehn ohlen, a Parapas!” (Parapas, iei aramas suwed men.)

footnotes.text: 18.40 PARAPAS: Ih ohl emen me mehn Rom kan salihedi pwehki eh wia moromor nan Serusalem oh kin uhwong kosonned en Rom.
